text:
emmeline: Quick heads-up \u2014 released redwood-plugins v0.3.0 with a mentor-backed plugin incubator. The release bundles new adapter templates, a 'how-to-maintain' checklist, and an onboarding path for new maintainers. Link + tiny runbook below. We'll run a Plugin Incubator kickoff + office hours next Tue 11am PT. Maintainers: please RSVP if you want to mentor.

release-bot: New release published: redwood-inference/redwood-plugins v0.3.0
https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-plugins/releases/tag/v0.3.0
Changelog: add http-adapter template, sqlite-dev shim, mentor-incubator docs, CONTRIBUTING updates, and security CI checks.

emmeline: Quick scaffold example (http-adapter):
```bash
npx @redwood-inference/create-plugin my-http-adapter --template http-adapter
cd my-http-adapter
npm ci
# run unit tests and example server
npm test && npm run example:dev
```

rafa: License? We should keep Apache-2.0 for templates to avoid downstream friction.

emmeline: Yes Apache-2.0. Incubator agreements are in INCUBATOR.md in the repo.

jin: Security note: the sqlite-dev shim is for local dev only and explicitly warns about not shipping DB files with secrets. I added a CI secret-scan GH Action.

olga: Love the mentor program. How do we nominate mentors?

devrel-bot: Plugin Incubator RSVP + mentor nomination form: https://forms.gle/example-incubator (tick mentor box if you want to pair-review PRs)

emmeline: Maintainers, please review MAINTAINERS.md and the new MAINTAINER_CHECKLIST before the kickoff. The office hours will cover onboarding PRs, security checklist, and how to run the example CI locally.

rafa: Can we get a two-line blurb for the community newsletter?

emmeline: "redwood-plugins v0.3 \u2014 new adapter templates + a mentor-backed Plugin Incubator to accelerate community-built integrations. Kickoff office hours Tue 11am PT \u2014 sign up to mentor or submit a plugin."

jin: I'll demo the http-adapter example during the kickoff. Need a co-presenter for CI/troubleshooting.

olga: I'll take the CI/troubleshooting part.

press-bot: Draft tweet for community channels ready: "New: redwood-plugins v0.3 + Plugin Incubator. Templates, mentor support, and onboarding docs to help maintainers ship adapters faster. Sign up: https://forms.gle/example-incubator #opensource #redwoodinference"

emmeline: Great. If you plan to submit an incubator plugin, open a draft PR early and add the INCUBATOR label so we can triage. See you Tuesday! :sparkles:
